QuestInfo.name: Agility Training
QuestInfo.0: #p2151003# thinks you should do some training. Go to #p2151010# at #m310010010# for training.
QuestInfo.1: This is a training program for improving the agility of Resistance trainees. You have to eliminate 15 #r#o9300409#s#k at #b#m310010100##k. Since they can vanish at will, you'll have to time your strikes carefully.
QuestInfo.2: You've finished the first training program. It seems like an eternity since you last did something so basic, but it felt good to have a little refresher after all those years.

0.0: Ready for some training? A little self-defense never hurt anyone! Except the bad guys, of course.
0.1: You look pretty experienced, so this should be no sweat for you. Our training program has three parts, and the first focuses on agility. Ready to test your reflexes?

yes.0: Agility Training is pretty simple. Enter #b#m310010100##k and eliminate #r15 #o9300409#s#k. Boom, done. Now, the challenge is that #o9300409#s can turn invisible. That means you have to time your attacks to hit them when they appear. It's tougher than it sounds.

no.0: I hope you can regain at least some of the powers that you've lost.

1.0: Oh, you've taken care of #o9300409#! The Resistance trainees really do build up strength with this program. Believe it.

yes.0: The next course is ready, so let me know when you want to start.

mob.0: I understand. It's not easy to defeat #r15 #o9300409#s#k. Don't push yourself too hard, we don't want you fainting again.
